_note: Total coverage on paper, seven of ten requirements standing in for a
measurement nobody made. Above MAX_ASSUMED_FRACTION the twin is no longer
reporting a measurement, it is reporting its own priors, and a verdict
from it would look exactly like one built on data.
Routes to: refuse, or sweep every assumption and report the range rather
than a number - never a point verdict.
This is the one fixture where a field other than the reason matters: the
route depends on COUNTING assumed provenances, and on each of them
carrying a plausible_range. It still never reads a value.
Every value below is the real fit from refute/calibration.py, relabelled.
That is deliberate: the fixture shows that provenance, not plausibility,
is what the gate must route on.
